title: Main menu
note: The live lobby stays behind a dim backdrop with an idle camera. There is no server browser: Host makes a game with a code, Join takes a code, Join by address (Direct) joins or hosts directly. Join, Direct and Settings are one ButtonGroup with allow_unpress: pressing one opens its panel beside the items, top-aligned with Host; pressing it again, Back or Esc (ui_cancel) closes it. Settings opens the Esc menu's Settings panel (s5 settings-sound), not drawn here.

states.label: Меню
states.note: The menu alone; keyboard focus starts on Host.

states.label: Код
states.note: Join pressed: the code panel, the field focused (empty when it opens; here three characters typed), Join unplugged.

states.label: Код готовий
states.note: Six valid characters typed: Join is enabled.

states.label: За адресою
states.note: Join by address pressed: the Direct panel, the address focused.

nodes.name: Backdrop
nodes.note: mouse_filter IGNORE; it dims the live lobby behind the menu.

nodes.name: Column
nodes.note: The game's name (Label ToyLogo, the working title "prime-game", auto_translate_mode DISABLED) is the first child, above NameRow; it is left out of this mock-up until the format can draw a text that is not a deck key.

children.name: Name
children.note: The player's name, kept between sessions (user://); never empty: the last name used, else the system user name. max_length as the game's name rule. auto_translate_mode DISABLED.

children.name: Body
children.note: The items, then the open panel (if any) to their right, its top on Host's top.

children.name: Items
children.note: Up and down move the focus through the items; the focused, hovered or pressed item shows its pointer icon.

children.name: Host
children.note: Focus on open. Hosts a game with a code (WebRTC) and goes straight to the lobby (s4); a failure shows s3 host-failed.

children.name: Join
children.note: toggle_mode true, in the menu ButtonGroup; button_pressed while CodePanel is open (ToyMenuItem's pressed StyleBox and pointer; drawn here as held). Toggles CodePanel.

children.name: Direct
children.note: toggle_mode true, in the menu ButtonGroup; button_pressed while DirectPanel is open (drawn here as held). Toggles DirectPanel.

children.name: Tutorial
children.note: Loads the tutorial's first lesson (s1).

children.name: Settings
children.note: toggle_mode true, in the menu ButtonGroup. Toggles the Esc menu's Settings panel code (s5 settings-sound, #301) in a ToyPanelMenu titled esc.tab.settings, a root of its own at @TOP_LEFT (838, 97), 941x886 (its left edge on the other panels' left edge; too tall to sit in Body): the mic, the mode, the threshold with its live meter, noise suppression and the volumes work without a session; nothing is sent.

children.name: Quit
children.note: Quits the game at once.

children.name: Gap
children.note: An empty spacer: 32 + 64 + 32 px between the items and the open panel. Shown with any panel.

children.name: CodePanel
children.note: Join with a code. Shown while Join is pressed.

children.name: Code
children.note: Focused and empty when the panel opens. max_length 6; upper-cases as typed, drops spaces and dashes on paste, accepts only the 31-letter code alphabet (no 0, O, 1, I, L). Keeps what was typed after a failure (back from s3). Enter = Join when it is enabled. auto_translate_mode DISABLED.

children.name: Join
children.note: Disabled (unplugged) until the field holds 6 valid characters. Joins by the code: s3 finding.

children.name: Back
children.note: Closes the panel and unpresses Join; Esc does the same.

children.name: DirectPanel
children.note: Join or host directly over ENet (LAN, VPN, playit.gg). Shown while Direct is pressed. No address is shown anywhere else (streams).

children.name: Address
children.note: Focused when the panel opens. Takes host or host:port, host names included (JoinTarget). Keeps what was typed after a failure. Enter = Join. auto_translate_mode DISABLED.

children.name: Port
children.note: The default port, used when the address has none.

children.name: Join
children.note: Disabled (unplugged) while Address is empty. Joins over ENet: s3 (the connecting steps, no code row).

children.name: Host
children.note: Hosts directly (ENet) on the port typed, else the default, and opens the lobby (s4) with no code row.

children.name: Back
children.note: Closes the panel and unpresses Direct; Esc does the same.
